description: This file defines a static class 'ImageValidators' that provides extension methods for validating image files based on their byte content and file extension.

classes.name: ImageValidators
classes.description: A static class containing methods for image validation, including checking file size and extension.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Checks if the provided byte array represents a valid image file based on non-nullity, size constraints, and extension validity.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Validates that the file extension belongs to an allowed set (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
